headline: Haas plans a Godzilla livery for Austin
body: Haas will reveal a new Godzilla-themed livery online on Monday 19 October for the United States Grand Prix. The design will be joined by matching race suits for Esteban Ocon and Oliver Bearman, with a themed show car on display at Austin's Barton Creek Square from 23–25 October.

headline: Ricciardo's Enchanté and Ford Racing plan an Austin pop-up
body: Daniel Ricciardo is heading to Austin on a road trip with musician Rob Baird after Ford's Raptor Rally in Arizona. Enchanté and Ford Racing will open a pop-up at Distribution Hall, 1500 East 4th Street, from 22–25 October.
